description: This file defines the class 'ConnectionBasedRabbitConnectionFactoryFactory' which is a factory class for creating RabbitMQ ConnectionFactory instances based on a given connection parameter. It includes methods for configuring connection properties and handling SSL setup, and implements a singleton pattern.

classes.name: ConnectionBasedRabbitConnectionFactoryFactory
classes.description: A singleton factory class for creating configured RabbitMQ ConnectionFactory instances based on Connection objects.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the factory.

methods.name: createConnectionFactory
methods.description: Creates and configures a ConnectionFactory based on the provided Connection, ExceptionHandler, and ConnectionLogger.

methods.name: configureConnectionFactory
methods.description: Configures the ConnectionFactory with specific parameters from the provided configuration map.

search-terms: Factory for creating RabbitMQ connection factories
